Header: Scirpophaga incertulas (Walker) In Sinhala: Kaha puruk panuwa, In Tamil: Manchal Santhu Kuthi

Prevention: Plough the field just after harvesting and impound water to the field
Raise level of irrigation water periodically and keep one day to submerge the eggs deposited on the lower parts of the plant
Encourage beneficial arthropods, wasps, ants, lady bird beetles, bugs, and mites, earwigs, bird, asilid fly, vespid wasp, spiders, birds.
Apply nitrogen fertilizer in split following the recommended rate and time of application.
Monitoring: Regular observation for egg masses on the leaves, dead heart and white heads
Threshold level: 10% dead heart or 5% white heads
Restrictions: Use protective clothing when applying pesticides
Don’t eat or drink while using pesticides and take suitable precautions when disposing of materials
Apply insecticides only when damage exceeds threshold levels
Chlorantraniliprole 20% +Thiamethoxam 20% 40WG WHO class - U Fipronil 0.3 % G. 12 kg /ha
